description:
Position : OnBase Developer
Location : Richmond, VA
Duration : 12 Months Plus 

OnBase Developer/ system administrator implementing and supporting imaging, workflow, work view and various other OnBase related technologies. Programming & custom scripting desired. 
 
 Skills should include:- 
 
 1...VB scripting (desired)
 2...HTML knowledge (desired)
 3...OnBase E-form development 
 4....Windows Server administration
 5....OnBase ECM product knowledge (OnBase certification preferred) 
 
 PROJECT MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE:- 
 Ability to provide expertise in developing ECM applications and automated solutions. 

 Ability to resolve technical defects and respond to technical inquiries 

 Ability to create and/or provide input to create comprehensive workflow designs within the ECM system including definition of requirements, system design (general and detailed), application development, testing, training, and implementation.Plans include detailed Work Breakdown Structures and target start/end dates, estimated hours, necessary resources, task dependencies, milestones, etc. 

 Ability to work with others establishing & facilitating meetings. Helps to identify meeting objectives, plans agendas, and ensures ground rules are maintained, meeting objectives are met, and minutes are documented. 

 Ability to conduct timely and thorough technical research and analysis of specialized technical applications, products, and tools. 

 Ability to participate in work sessions to gather business and technical requirements. 

 Ability to design internal solutions and external system interface mechanisms, including appropriate application of techniques and standards such as service-oriented architecture, web services, etc. 

 Ability to develop conceptual system designs and implement strategies utilizing specialized applications, products, and tools 

 Ability to perform highly complex technical development, configuration, implementation, and support tasks including programming, testing and maintenance of specialized applications, solutions and products (such as, Document Imaging, Automated Workflow, e-Forms, Automated Correspondence, Business Rules Management, etc.) 

 Ability to ensure all programming and configuration work is functional with no unexpected results encountered to prepare for integration and acceptance testing. 

 

 For the more Information please contact me at 734-357-8988 or sathish dot balla at tekwissen dot com
